- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:188-223 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In map_entry, the new `if name is not None and not names: return "unverified", "names_incomplete"` branch returns before the pytest `ERROR <node>` summary regex can run, because that check only runs inside `if name is not None and names:`.
  WHY: A fixture setup or teardown error that only produces `ERROR tests/x.py::test_y` (failing_names gives `[]`) now maps to `unverified/names_incomplete` instead of `reproduced/regression`, which blocks `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL: REPRODUCIBLE` and makes heal_isolated_implement.sh run 1 report unverified; severity disagreement: sonnet, minimax and luna said MAJOR, gemini said BLOCKER, so the highest is used.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:232-238 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the map_entry inherited branch, a listed `::name` test that fails through a pytest setup ERROR on both trees has `names == []` (failing_names in prepush_affected_tests.py:703-729 matches neither `_FAILED_RE` nor `_UNITTEST_RE`), and inherited items carry no tail, so it always maps to `unverified/names_incomplete` instead of `pre_existing`.
  WHY: heal_isolated_implement.sh run 2 cannot prove `at_failing()`, so cmd_final gives `outcome=unverified`, the script exits 43, and `implement_heal_preflight.sh refuse repro_not_fixed` refuses correct fixes; severity disagreement: sonnet and minimax said MAJOR, gemini said BLOCKER, glm gave none, so the highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:442-452 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_recurred_marker_landed` (caller at lines 643-650) returns the same result for "marker not present" and "GET or parse failed", so a failed read counts as "the marker did not land".
  WHY: If both POSTs stored the `recurred` comment but reported errors and the GET then also fails, the script re-closes the heal, and on the next tick cmd_select skips it as `already_verified`, so the recurrence follow-up and escalation are lost for good; severity disagreement: sonnet said NIT, gemini, minimax and luna said MAJOR, glm gave none, so the highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:448 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The comment list query in `_recurred_marker_landed` uses per_page=100 with no pagination, so a recurrence marker beyond the first 100 comments since the merge is missed.
  WHY: On active heal issues the marker is missed, so the heal is silently re-closed and then skipped; sonnet mentioned this case inside its read-failure finding but did not file it separately.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh:95 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The bundle sanitizer's second expression `-e 's/^===/= = =/'` only neutralises `===` in column 0, so an indented fake header such as `   === HEAL PLAN TASK ===` reaches the plan/clarify/implement-preflight bundle unchanged, unlike scripts/clarify_github_facts.py render_heal_evidence_pack (137-142).
  WHY: Untrusted issue-body text that looks like a prompt-section header can reach the model prompt (scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:302-304), the two consumers now give different protection, and agents.d/heal-evidence-pack-consumers.md says both rewrite `===` lines; severity disagreement: sonnet and luna said NIT, gemini and minimax said MAJOR, glm gave none, so the highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:_verify_one | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The script performs one jobs read per failed run without per-heal API usage capping.
  WHY: High-volume failure reports are likely to hit GitHub API rate limits and cause read_budget errors that delay heal verification.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:79-79,447-448 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The marker GET in `_recurred_marker_landed` increments `TOTAL_READS` but is not checked against `MAX_READS_PER_HEAL=3`, unlike lines 529 and 592.
  WHY: On the path where both POSTs fail, a fourth per-heal REST read happens (runs list, compare, jobs, comments), which goes over the "at most 3 REST reads, D4" budget documented in agents.d/heal-verify.md and the P7 plan; all reviewers rated NIT.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh:95 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `sed -E -e 's/={3}([[:space:]]*(BEGIN|END)[[:space:]]+UNTRUSTED)/= = =\1/Ig' -e 's/^===/= = =/'` only rewrites `===` in column 0, so `   === HEAL PLAN TASK ===` reaches the bundle prompt unchanged. This does not match clarify_github_facts.py render_heal_evidence_pack or agents.d/heal-evidence-pack-consumers.md.
  WHY: An indented fake header reaches the planner and implement-preflight bundle. Suggested fix: `-e 's/^([[:space:]]*)===/\1= = =/'`.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:220-223 (ERROR check at 200-202, guarded at 188) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: failing_names (workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:703-710) never parses pytest `ERROR path::name`. The new `names_incomplete` return fires before the ERROR-summary regex, so a setup or teardown error maps to `unverified/names_incomplete` instead of `reproduced/regression`.
  WHY: With WORKFLOW_HEAL_REPRODUCE_ENABLED=true the intake records `unverified`, the planner cannot use `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL: REPRODUCIBLE`, and run 1 reports `unverified` instead of `still_failing`. Fix: compute `tail`/`node` outside the guard and run the ERROR regex first.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:232-238 (with prepush_affected_tests.py:946) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: An inherited `::name` unit counts as `pre_existing` only when the name was parsed. A setup ERROR on both trees gives `names == []`, and inherited items carry no tail, so the result is always `unverified/names_incomplete`.
  WHY: Run 2 cannot prove `at_failing()`, so cmd_final gives `outcome=unverified`, the script exits 43, and `refuse repro_not_fixed` refuses a correct fix. Fix: keep `pre_existing` when names are empty and the path has exactly one listed `::name` entry.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (live copy not updated; tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:49) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The template changed but the live copy did not, and .github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json has no entry. CI on head 04a7ae4d (run 41346530580, job 124967422879) fails.
  WHY: tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and `lint` are red. Pipeline editors cannot write `.claude/**`, so a trusted session must sync the file or a divergence entry must be added.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:442-452 (caller 643-650; already_verified 303-317) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed comments GET, or a marker beyond the first 100 comments (`per_page=100`, no pagination), counts as not landed, so the heal is re-closed and the next tick skips it as `already_verified`.
  WHY: After one POST response error plus one read error, a fix that did not hold is never re-verified. Fix: when the GET fails, leave the heal open and log a warning (about 5 lines).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:79, 447 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `TOTAL_READS=$((TOTAL_READS + 1))` in _recurred_marker_landed has no MAX_READS_PER_HEAL check (unlike lines 529 and 592), which allows a fourth REST read.
  WHY: The code drifts from agents.d/heal-verify.md "at most 3 REST reads, D4".
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE (no linked issue body; plan phases P1-P7 each have diff hunks; the `_plan_heal_counterfactual_check` gap is documented as known/deferred in agents.d/heal-regression-plan-gate.md and agents.d/heal-counterfactual-reproducible.md).
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS repeat the fixes for evidence.sh line 95 (2 lines, plus a mirror case in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_evidence_bundle.py), heal_reproduce.sh map_entry 188-223 (4 lines) and _recurred_marker_landed (5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3 (3 related items)
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
